Strong Warning About Dr. Parham

I would strongly caution pet owners about seeing Dr. Param at this clinic or at any other practice where he provides veterinary care.

After spending thousands of dollars on my dog’s care, I came away deeply concerned about the approach taken. As a physician myself, I recognized what felt to me like a lack of clear medical strategy, thoughtful planning, and genuine attention to the animal’s overall well-being.

My experience left me with the strong impression that financial considerations were prioritized over patient care. I found the experience extremely upsetting and, in my opinion, deeply unethical.

Our animals depend entirely on us to advocate for them, and they deserve veterinarians who treat them with compassion, careful judgment, and genuine concern—not simply as another source of revenue.

Based on my personal experience, I would strongly recommend that pet owners do their research and consider other veterinary options before placing their animal in this doctor’s care.
The team has provided great care for our pet and was handling every request as professional as it can be. Can only recommend this clinic. :)

We’ve had nothing but exceptional experiences at Homer Animal Hospital. Their entire team genuinely loves animals and you can tell. They’re patient with puppies jumping all around and are super diligent with timing/scheduling of vaccinations. There has never been another animal in the waiting room so my puppy and I aren’t over stimulated. The pricing is fantastic & their bookings are super easy & flexible.

Are you worried about how the veterinary industry has sold off to corporate interests? Wondering where to turn for honest, ethical veterinary advice? Wanting to understand the root cause of the problem, as opposed to simply treating issues with a variety of pharmaceuticals?

After a spate of disreputable clinics in the United States--who continually stonewall when questioned about their unethical practices-- I was super grateful to stumble upon this family-owned clinic in my hour of need.

The clinic accommodated a last-minute appointment, gave me reasonable and measured advice, and charged an exceptionally fair price. Within 24 hours, my dog was back on the road to health.

I cannot recommend them highly enough.

I am a young person on an extremely tight budget, usually very healthy dog had been sick for a few days prior to his appointment which was purposely booked on my day off as missing work is not an option for me.

During his examination I was told there was nothing to worry about, I didn’t want to leave with no resolution for him so I asked for a dewormer since his bowel movements suggested otherwise, they sent us on our way and I received a follow up email the next day asking how he was doing, I explained that his symptoms have persisted and he is still struggling. The RAPS team then called me to get him booked in again, I mentioned that I work full time and can come again on Saturday for the follow up, they called me back shortly after to say that they are concerned, that it is urgent and he needs to be seen as soon as possible.

Their soonest availability was 9am the following day, so i rearranged my schedule and I took the day off work with very little notice. At the follow up I was disappointed with how the examination was handled, there was no trust building with my easily spooked large dog, no warm up time or treats offered, just right into the hands on examination, my dog tolerated the initial interaction but eventually became overwhelmed and uncomfortable resulting in a few back off barks.

The full exam was not completed but I was still charged a “re-check” fee, I have a few problems with this, I did not request an additional appointment, I was contacted and encouraged to return due to ongoing concerns. The symptoms were the same symptoms present during the original appointment, only now requiring another visit and another charge, and a full examination was not even performed at the follow up.

I took up their offer to speak with the manager and remained open minded, however there was no initial interest in letting me explain the situation, no questions were asked, only immediate reinforcement that the re-check fee is for the doctors time, I politely waited for her to finish and then briefly explained that I myself had spent significant time, travel, and lost wages attending two appointments for an issue that should’ve been resolved during one

I am asking that this situation be reviewed, including whether the re-check fee was appropriate given the circumstances. I value veterinarians time but I also feel that my time and money spent should be acknowledged in return.

Thank you for taking the time to review my concerns. I look forward to hearing your response.

We had a very good experience at Homer Animal Hospital during Marco’s (our little Maltese-Shih Tzu) dental procedure. Dr. Gurinder Sidhu and Melika took great care of him and made what could have been a stressful experience feel calm and reassuring.

Their communication was excellent from start to finish. They clearly explained the procedure, walked us through what to expect, and were very open about options, risks, and follow-up care. We never felt rushed, and all of our questions were answered thoughtfully and honestly.

Most importantly, Marco was treated with genuine kindness and compassion. It was clear that his comfort and well-being were their top priority. We felt informed, supported, and confident that he was in very capable hands.

We’re thankful for the care Marco received and would highly recommend Homer Animal Hospital to anyone looking for a veterinary team that is professional, transparent, and genuinely caring.
